summary: Compute-on-read read-side feature, no new persisted domain entity -- same pattern as FINTRACK-19/20. GetWeeklyRecommendationHandler checks 3 trigger types (BUDGET_RISK: any budget >=80% of monthly limit; NEW_SUBSCRIPTION: any DETECTED subscription first seen in the trailing 7 days; SPENDING_SPIKE: a category's trailing-7-day spend >=1.5x its 4-week baseline average, only when a real baseline exists) in a fixed priority order, with a neutral fallback when none fire. Resolved BA's open question on priority ordering: BUDGET_RISK > NEW_SUBSCRIPTION > SPENDING_SPIKE. No new repository port methods -- reuses sum_by_category_for_user_in_range and list_for_user, avoiding a breaking Fake-repository change on top of an already 5-point story. GET /api/v1/recommendations/weekly, user_id from JWT only. Smoke-tested locally (fake repos) before handoff: budget-risk, neutral, new-subscription-only, spending-spike-only, multi-trigger priority resolution, cross-user scoping.

payload.architecture_decision: Priority order for simultaneous triggers: BUDGET_RISK > NEW_SUBSCRIPTION > SPENDING_SPIKE (documented in get_weekly_recommendation.py's module docstring; resolves BA's open question)
